title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The document explains the AI Office’s decision on how artificial intelligence should be managed and used within the organization. It sets out clear guidelines for compliance, risk assessment, and governance to promote responsible and safe AI practices.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: The document announces a vacant position for technology specialists in an AI office, outlining the role’s responsibilities and the impact it will have on AI projects. It also details the qualifications and experience required, and provides information on how to apply for the position.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: The document announces a vacancy for a Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office, outlining the role’s key responsibilities and expectations. It also provides the qualifications and experience required for candidates applying to the position.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This policy outlines how AI tools can be used to identify, assess, and fill vacancies for legal officer positions. It provides guidelines to ensure fairness, compliance, and effective integration of AI into the hiring process.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: This document explains how vacancies in AI policy offices are identified and addressed, detailing the steps to fill these positions. It outlines the responsibilities, selection criteria, and roles that policy officers will take on once appointed.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a body created to offer expert scientific analysis and advice on the AI Act. It reviews AI technologies, assesses potential risks, and recommends safeguards to ensure responsible AI development and deployment.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The draft is a request to develop a set of common standards for a particular area. It stresses the importance of consistency and clear guidelines to ensure reliable and trustworthy outcomes.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: The CoP Consultation Notice announces an upcoming consultation on a set of proposed guidelines or policies. It invites stakeholders to review the draft and submit comments so that the final version can be refined.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: This document announces a call for people to express their interest in joining a Community of Practice (CoP) that focuses on AI policy. Interested individuals are invited to respond so they can learn more about the CoP’s goals, activities, and how they can get involved.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: The policy explains how the Community of Practice (CoP) uses a graphic to illustrate the iterative drafting process for AI policies, showing the cyclical stages of drafting, review, feedback, and revision. It emphasizes continuous improvement and collaboration among stakeholders to refine policy documents.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: The document is a graphic timeline that illustrates the drafting process for the CoP. It visually maps out the main stages, key dates, and milestones involved in developing the policy.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document presents the first draft of a Code of Practice for the responsible development and use of AI systems. It outlines key principles, standards, and recommended procedures designed to promote safety, fairness, transparency, and alignment with societal values.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This policy document outlines the second draft of the Code of Practice for the organization, detailing the expected behaviors and responsibilities of its members. It serves as a guide to ensure consistent, ethical, and effective conduct in all operations.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: The “Code of Practice: 3rd Draft” is a set of guidelines designed to help organizations use artificial intelligence responsibly and safely. It outlines best‑practice standards and responsibilities for developers, users, and stakeholders to promote ethical, transparent, and trustworthy AI deployment.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft is a proposed agreement aimed at establishing common standards and responsibilities for the development and use of artificial intelligence. It seeks to promote transparency, fairness, and accountability in AI systems through shared principles and collaborative oversight.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a set of guidelines and commitments that aim to ensure the safe, ethical, and responsible development and deployment of AI technologies. It outlines principles, responsibilities, and governance structures for stakeholders to promote transparency, accountability, and alignment with societal values.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: The document lists the types of artificial‑intelligence activities that are prohibited, such as using AI for disallowed content, harmful decision‑making, or unauthorized data manipulation. It serves as a clear guideline for developers and users to avoid these practices and comply with legal and ethical standards.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This guideline outlines how to define an AI system, including its components, scope, and boundaries. It provides principles for identifying AI capabilities and ensuring clear, consistent definitions across organizations.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy focuses on increasing support for start‑ups and fostering innovation in the economy. It outlines strategies to enhance communication, collaboration, and resource sharing among entrepreneurs, investors, and government agencies.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups is a program that offers high‑performance computing resources, training, and support to early‑stage companies. It helps these startups accelerate innovation and product development by tapping into Europe’s leading HPC infrastructure and expertise.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This policy outlines the principles and procedures for managing risks associated with AI systems. It provides guidelines for assessing potential hazards, implementing safeguards, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar covers the fundamentals of risk management in AI, explaining key concepts and best practices. Participants will learn how to identify, assess, and mitigate AI‑related risks to ensure safe and responsible deployment.
